notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Storm VR
notes.content:
Storm VR is Now Available on Steam!

Storm is an atmospheric survival game. This is the first, short introduction to a series of episodes of Storm. You wake up in an intense snowstorm. As you look around for ways to get out of the biting cold, to somehow find shelter, your body gets colder, your hands freeze up, and the storm intensifies. And as you slowly move forward a bigger question rises: who are you? Where are you? How did you get here?

notes.title: Last Steps
notes.content: We've just updated the Snowstorm, with a new visual style and some other improvements. If you experience any bugs let us know. You'll see a glimpse of the desert Storm in there too.

notes.title: Update 14 Nov
notes.content:
Hi everyone, just a quick message to let you know that we added Oculus Rift support (w Touch) although there are a couple of small bugs we're still hunting down. We're also looking into upgrading the visual quality of the Snowstorm level in the coming weeks, just before we come out of Early Access. The way that Storm looks has been something we didn't prioritize as much as we would have liked to while we were building the level itself. But at this point it's something worth spending some time on, so I'll keep you posted.

Finally, we've made some early, yet significant first steps on the Desert episode, which will be our next. As I mentioned in a previous update, our upcoming levels will be larger in scope and focus much more on story. But the first step is obvious the storm environment itself. We've taken the first steps to create a sandstorm that will make you feel like your skin is coming off. 

We'd love to show you guys a wip. 

I'll let you know about that in the coming weeks. Excited to share it with you.

Any thoughts, just shout.

Anrick

notes.title: Now Available on Steam Early Access - Storm VR
notes.content:
Storm VR is Now Available on Steam Early Access!

Storm is an episodic indie game, made from the ground up for Virtual Reality by a small team. The first episode, Snowstorm, is out now for the HTC Vive.
